examples.arabic: عمر بيحب البحر وهو فرحان قوي
examples.english: Omar loves the sea and he is very happy.
examples.transliteration: Omar beyheb el baher wa howa farhan awy

examples.english: Mom loves the sea very much.
My family will eat fish by the sea.
examples.transliteration: Eylety hatakol samak ala el bahr

examples.arabic: بس مراتي عايزة تروح البحر في الغردقة
examples.english: But my wife wants to go to the sea in Hurghada
examples.transliteration: bas meraty ayza teroh el bahr fe el ghardaqa

examples.arabic: ممكن يروح اسكندرية يشوف البحر هناك
examples.english: Maybe he will go to Alexandria to see the sea there.
examples.transliteration: Momken yerūḥ Eskandareyya yeshūf el-baḥr henāk.

examples.arabic: احنا عايزين نروح البحر بكرة الصبح
examples.english: We want to go to the sea tomorrow morning.
